## Revision History

- R2: Added `try_push_back` and the overflow policy table.
- R1: Renamed `ring_buffer` to `ring_span` per LEWG feedback.
- R0: Initial revision.

## Motivation

Embedded and real-time code needs a circular container over caller-owned storage that never allocates. Every large codebase carries its own ring_span.

The `try_push_back` member returns `false` instead of overwriting when the span is full.

## Design

`std::ring_span` is a non-owning view over a contiguous range that overwrites the oldest element when full.

| Policy | On full | Allocates |
| --- | --- | --- |
| overwrite | drops oldest | no |
| reject | returns false | no |

```cpp
std::array<int, 4> storage;
std::ring_span<int> ring(storage);
ring.push_back(1);
ring.push_back(2);
```

## Wording

Add a new subclause to [views.contiguous]:

> The class template `ring_span` provides a circular view over a contiguous sequence of objects. Inserting into a full `ring_span` replaces the oldest element.
